knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Damp and wet methods keep dust out of the air. Dry sweeping and blowing both disperse it.
A filter that is damaged or full allows fine dust to escape back into the room, so it is checked before use.
Outdoor cleaning waits while strong gusts would carry dust or debris.

practicalCriteria: Selects a damp or dry-wipe method for a named surface and gives the reason
Checks a filtered vacuum's filter and bag before use
Dusts a high point top to bottom and captures dust on the cloth
Stops outdoor work when a simulated gust is called
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: Dry sweeping is used in an occupied area where a damp method is suitable
Compressed air is used to clear dust in an occupied room
